clinician_credentials_shape_check.name: clinician_credentials_shape_check
clinician_credentials_shape_check.value:
case "operational"."clinician_credentials"."kind"
        when 'registration' then "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registering_body" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registration_status" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."reference" is not null
          and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."expires_on" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."endorsement" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."insurer" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."covers_telehealth_new_patients" is null
        when 'endorsement' then "operational"."clinician_credentials"."endorsement" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registering_body" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registration_status" is null
          and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registration_type" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."conditions" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."insurer" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."covers_telehealth_new_patients" is null
        when 'indemnity' then "operational"."clinician_credentials"."insurer" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."covers_telehealth_new_patients" is not null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."expires_on" is not null
          and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registering_body" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registration_status" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."registration_type" is null
          and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."conditions" is null and "operational"."clinician_credentials"."endorsement" is null
        else false end

clinician_credentials_dates_check.name: clinician_credentials_dates_check
clinician_credentials_dates_check.value: "operational"."clinician_credentials"."starts_on" is null or "operational"."clinician_credentials"."expires_on" is null or "operational"."clinician_credentials"."starts_on" <= "operational"."clinician_credentials"."expires_on"

clinicians_suspension_check.name: clinicians_suspension_check
clinicians_suspension_check.value: ("operational"."clinicians"."suspended_at" is null) = ("operational"."clinicians"."suspension_reason" is null) and ("operational"."clinicians"."suspended_at" is null) = ("operational"."clinicians"."suspended_by" is null)

patients_ihi_check.name: patients_ihi_check
patients_ihi_check.value: ("clinical"."patients"."ihi" is null) = ("clinical"."patients"."ihi_status" is null) and ("clinical"."patients"."ihi" is null) = ("clinical"."patients"."ihi_record_status" is null)

patient_consents_staff_reason_check.name: patient_consents_staff_reason_check
patient_consents_staff_reason_check.value: ("clinical"."patient_consents"."recorded_by" is null) or ("clinical"."patient_consents"."reason" is not null and length(trim("clinical"."patient_consents"."reason")) > 0)

identity_checks_manual_check.name: identity_checks_manual_check
identity_checks_manual_check.value: ("clinical"."identity_checks"."method" = 'document' and "clinical"."identity_checks"."checked_by" is null) or ("clinical"."identity_checks"."method" = 'manual' and "clinical"."identity_checks"."checked_by" is not null and "clinical"."identity_checks"."outcome" = 'verified' and length(trim(coalesce("clinical"."identity_checks"."reason", ''))) > 0)

protocol_versions_sign_off_check.name: protocol_versions_sign_off_check
protocol_versions_sign_off_check.value: ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."status" = 'draft') = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signed_off_at" is null) and ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signed_off_at" is null) = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signed_off_by" is null) and ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signed_off_at" is null) = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signer_registration" is null) and ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."signed_off_at" is null) = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."attestation" is null)

protocol_versions_withdrawn_check.name: protocol_versions_withdrawn_check
protocol_versions_withdrawn_check.value: ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."status" = 'withdrawn') = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."withdrawn_at" is not null) and ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("clinical"."protocol_versions"."withdrawn_reason" is null)

intakes_holder_check.name: intakes_holder_check
intakes_holder_check.value: "clinical"."intakes"."patient_id" is not null or "clinical"."intakes"."resume_token_hash" is not null or "clinical"."intakes"."cleared_at" is not null

block_rules_value_check.name: block_rules_value_check
block_rules_value_check.value:
case "platform"."block_rules"."match"
        when 'compounded' then "platform"."block_rules"."value" is null
        when 'schedule' then "platform"."block_rules"."value" ~ '^S[2348]$'
        when 'artg_number' then "platform"."block_rules"."value" ~ '^[0-9]{3,8}$'
        else false end

consults_started_check.name: consults_started_check
consults_started_check.value: "clinical"."consults"."status" not in ('in_progress', 'completed') or "clinical"."consults"."started_at" is not null
